Applications Engineer - Thread Rolling Solutions Team

Brinkman Products - CJWinter Division

Location: Rochester, NY

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary Range: $75,000 - $105,000 annually, based on experience

About Brinkman Products

Brinkman Products, Inc. is an industrial manufacturing company encompassing two specialized divisions: Davenport Machine and CJWinter. Together, we manufacture proprietary product lines including Davenport multi-spindle screw machines, thread rolling attachments, thread rolls, and precision tooling solutions serving manufacturers worldwide.

We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Applications Engineer to join our CJWinter Thread Rolling Solutions Team. This position is ideal for a mid-level engineer who enjoys solving manufacturing challenges, working directly with customers, and developing practical thread rolling solutions for real-world production applications.

This role combines technical expertise, hands-on problem solving, customer interaction, project management, and process development to support the successful implementation of thread rolling processes and tooling solutions across a wide range of industries.

What You'll Do

As part of the Thread Rolling Solutions Team, you will help customers improve productivity, quality, and profitability through optimized thread rolling solutions and innovative manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate customer applications and recommend thread rolling solutions, tooling, and process improvements
  • Review customer drawings, specifications, material requirements, and production objectives to develop optimal thread rolling processes
  • Develop, validate, and document thread rolling processes for new and existing applications
  • Support customer trials, process validation, troubleshooting, and production implementation activities
  • Work hands-on with thread rolling attachments, rolls, tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing equipment
  • Troubleshoot customer production issues and provide technical recommendations to improve quality, productivity, and tool life
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, product development, and sales teams to ensure successful execution of customer projects
  • Assist in the development, testing, and commercialization of new thread rolling products, technologies, and manufacturing solutions
  • Prepare quotations, technical proposals, cost estimates, and application recommendations
  • Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations
  • Support new business opportunities while maintaining strong relationships with existing customers
  • Travel to customer facilities as needed to support installations, process optimization, training, and application development (approximately 5-15%)
  • Document application data, test results, lessons learned, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3-7 years of experience in applications engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, tooling, machining, or a related technical role
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment

Technical Qualifications

  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, and technical specifications
  • Experience with machining, metalworking, tooling, fastening systems, or cold-forming processes preferred
  • Knowledge of thread rolling processes, tooling, or precision manufacturing is a plus
  • Proficiency with SolidWorks or other 3D CAD software and parametric modeling preferred
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with HubSpot and Infor ERP systems preferred

Professional Skills

  • Excellent communication and customer-facing skills
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal teams
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to travel as required to support customer applications and projects

Why This Role Appeals to Engineers

Hands-On Engineering

Work directly with equipment, tooling, manufacturing processes, and customer applications.

Customer Impact

Help solve real-world manufacturing challenges and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and profitability.

Technical Variety

Gain exposure to a diverse range of materials, products, manufacturing methods, equipment, and industries.

Innovation

Contribute to the development of next-generation thread rolling technologies, tooling, and manufacturing solutions.

Career Growth

Expand your expertise in specialized manufacturing technology while taking ownership of meaningful projects with industry-leading customers.

Collaborative Environment

Work alongside experienced engineering, manufacturing, sales, and product development professionals in a highly supportive team environment.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive salary of $75,000 - $105,000, based on experience
  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous employer-funded Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Generous paid time off program plus 10 paid holidays annually
  • Professional development, technical training, and career advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that promotes continuous learning, innovation, and long-term growth

Join Our Team

If you enjoy solving manufacturing challenges, working directly with customers, and developing innovative thread rolling solutions that drive measurable results, we'd like to hear from you. Join Brinkman Products and help shape the future of thread rolling technology.

EOE, including disability/vets.



For more information, or to apply now, you must go to the website below. Please DO NOT email your resume to us as we only accept applications through our website.

https://cjwinter.applicantpro.com/jobs/4222182-1086031.html

Sales & Customer Support Specialist - Thread Rolling Solutions Team

Brinkman Products - CJWinter Division Location: Rochester, NY Job Type: Full-Time Salary Range: $55,000 - $85,000 annually, based on experience

About Brinkman Products

Brinkman Products, Inc. is an industrial manufacturing company encompassing two specialized divisions: Davenport Machine and CJWinter. Together, we manufacture proprietary product lines including Davenport multi-spindle screw machines, thread rolling attachments, thread rolls, and precision tooling solutions serving manufacturers worldwide.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sales & Customer Support Specialist to join our CJWinter Thread Rolling Solutions Team. This position is ideal for an individual with strong technical aptitude and a customer-focused mindset who enjoys working with manufacturing products, supporting customers, processing orders, and helping deliver practical solutions to real-world production challenges.

This role serves as a key link between customers, sales engineers, engineering, manufacturing, and shipping teams to ensure accurate quoting, efficient order processing, timely delivery, and exceptional customer support.

What You'll Do

As part of the Thread Rolling Solutions Team, you will help customers receive the right products, technical support, and timely service while supporting the sales and operational functions of the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare quotations and process orders for thread rolling attachments, thread rolls, tooling, spare parts, and related products.
  • Review customer drawings, specifications, and application information to ensure accurate quotations, order entry, and product selection.
  • Serve as a primary customer contact for quotations, order status, lead times, shipping schedules, product availability, and basic technical inquiries.
  • Coordinate closely with engineering, manufacturing, sales, and purchasing teams to ensure customer requirements, delivery dates, and product specifications are clearly understood and executed.
  • Work with shipping personnel and freight providers to coordinate domestic and international shipments, prepare required documentation, and ensure on-time delivery of customer orders.
  • Support outside sales engineers by preparing quotations, technical documentation, proposals, and customer follow-up activities.
  • Maintain accurate customer, quotation, and order information within CRM and ERP systems while tracking open quotes and supporting sales growth initiatives.
  • Assist in resolving customer issues related to orders, shipments, delivery schedules, product specifications, and returns while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Support trade shows, customer visits, sales initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts that enhance customer service and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree, technical certification, business degree, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • 2-5 years of experience in customer service, inside sales, order entry, sales support, manufacturing, industrial distribution, or a related environment.
  • Experience supporting technical products and manufacturing customers is preferred.

Technical Qualifications

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in manufacturing products and processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic engineering drawings and specifications preferred.
  • Familiarity with machining, tooling, industrial equipment, fasteners, or manufacturing environments is a plus.
  • Experience with ERP systems, CRM software, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when preparing quotations, entering orders, and coordinating shipments.

Professional Skills

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn technical products and applications.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, freight providers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Positive attitude and commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Why This Role Appeals to Candidates

Customer Impact

Play a direct role in supporting customers and ensuring a positive experience from quotation through delivery.

Technical Exposure

Learn about advanced manufacturing processes, precision tooling, and thread rolling technology without requiring an engineering degree.

Career Growth

Develop expertise in industrial products, inside sales, customer support, manufacturing operations, and international business.

Variety

Work with customers, products, and applications across a wide range of industries while coordinating sales, operations, and logistics activities.

Team Environment

Collaborate with experienced sales, engineering, manufacturing, and customer support professionals in a highly supportive environment.

Stability

Join a well-established manufacturing company with proprietary products and a strong reputation in the industry.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employer-funded Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Generous paid time off plus 10 paid holidays annually
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that promotes continuous learning and growth

Join Our Team

If you enjoy working with customers, supporting technical products, coordinating orders, shipments, and logistics, and helping ensure a smooth customer experience from quotation through delivery, we'd like to hear from you. Join Brinkman Products and become an important part of our growing Thread Rolling Solutions Team.

EOE, including disability/vets.



For more information, or to apply now, you must go to the website below. Please DO NOT email your resume to us as we only accept applications through our website.

https://cjwinter.applicantpro.com/jobs/4222190-1086031.html
